# PromoPower Pte Ltd

> PromoPower is a MOM licensed employment agency (EA License No. 20C0109) in Singapore, established in 2002. We provide professional staffing solutions for promotions, retail activations, events, roadshows and customer engagement campaigns.

PromoPower is a workforce partner — not a creative or experiential agency. We support customer-facing campaigns through recruitment, preparation, deployment and operational coordination.

## Contact

- Email: admin@promopower.com.sg
- Address: 65 Airport Boulevard, #03-37 Changi Airport Terminal 3, Singapore 819663
- Website: https://promopower.com.sg

## Services

- [Brand Ambassadors](https://promopower.com.sg/services/brand-ambassadors): Product launches, demonstrations, retail activations and sampling
- [Event Personnel](https://promopower.com.sg/services/event-personnel): Registration, ushering, guest management and event operations
- [Retail Activation Teams](https://promopower.com.sg/services/retail-activation-teams): Multi-location retail campaigns and in-store engagement
- [Roadshows & Consumer Engagement](https://promopower.com.sg/services/roadshows-consumer-engagement): Islandwide roadshows and public activations
- [Campaign Support & Coordination](https://promopower.com.sg/services/campaign-support-coordination): Supervisors, scheduling and on-ground coordination
